user.title: Choose a connection
user.description: Choose HTTP API or MQTT through your existing Home Assistant broker.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add discovered PrintDeck
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} was found at `{host}`. Enable Unified Printer API in [PrintDeck Web Config]({configuration_url}) and enter its token.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the PrintDeck token
reauth_confirm.description: The current Unified API token was rejected. Enter the active token from PrintDeck Web Config.

reconfigure.title: Choose a connection
reconfigure.description: Choose HTTP API or MQTT through your existing Home Assistant broker.

http.title: HTTP API
http.description: Enable Unified Printer API in [PrintDeck Web Config]({configuration_url}), then enter the local host and API token.

data_description.host: For example, printdeck.local or the local IP address shown by PrintDeck.
data_description.token: The token shown in Settings > Unified API in PrintDeck Web Config.

mqtt.title: Connect through MQTT
mqtt.description: Configure MQTT in Home Assistant and PrintDeck using the same broker. Disable automatic Home Assistant Discovery in PrintDeck and wait for its MQTT entities to disappear, then enter the topic root shown by PrintDeck. The PrintDeck integration will manage the entities.

data_description.topic_root: For example: printdeck/printdeck-a1b2c3d4e5f6/v1. Do not enter the broker address.

error.invalid_auth: The Unified API token is not valid.
error.api_disabled: Unified Printer API is disabled. Enable it in PrintDeck Web Config.
error.unsupported_firmware: Update PrintDeck firmware to a version that supports the Home Assistant integration.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid local host and API token.
error.mqtt_not_ready: Configure and connect the MQTT integration in Home Assistant first.
error.mqtt_no_device: No PrintDeck identity received. Check the broker, device connection and topic root.
error.invalid_topic_root: Enter the complete topic root shown by PrintDeck.
error.mqtt_discovery_conflict: Disable automatic Home Assistant Discovery in PrintDeck, wait for cleanup and removal of its MQTT entities, then try again.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered service did not include a valid PrintDeck identity.

mqtt_discovery_conflict.title: PrintDeck MQTT entity ownership
mqtt_discovery_conflict.description: PrintDeck automatic MQTT Discovery is enabled, cleanup is pending, or standard MQTT entities still exist. Disable automatic Discovery in PrintDeck Web Config and wait for its old MQTT entities to be removed. PrintDeck entities remain unavailable until this is resolved.
